Reference image for [[Jokes#Joh_Yowza|Jokes]] on [[Joh Yowza]]: a jam session, musicians playing together informally. A bluegrass music jam at the Delafield Fish Hatchery in Delafield, Wisconsin, on 8 February 2009.
